invariants.rationale: The method unconditionally returns a new TableWriteStats instance, which should not be null.
The method body uses writeMetadata without null checks, so it must be non-null.
The returned TableWriteStats is constructed directly from the mapped list of stats of writeStatuses from writeMetadata.
Each WriteStatus from writeMetadata corresponds to exactly one stat in the result.
If the input list is empty, the result's stat list is also empty; otherwise, it is non-empty.
